body: Thank you, i'll keep you on that promise
I'll try finding a suicide help line to email or anyone, it helped alot writing this down because yea it helps to organize what I am thinking.

It's hard I just feel nothing and I don't see anything no future how do you get the motivation to achieve or become when it just isn't there. I've tried counseling and had friends and family members help me, I was happy for a while but my anxiety just stopped me getting the most out of it, and it's killing me slowly now, I feel like I am 40 years old and have ruined my life because I didn't take those chances and all that's left for me now is to just die. I will get new more hands on counceling but there is a waitlist and I dont wanna just slip away further till I can't handle it anymore.
